name: threat-stack
description: A marketplace of threat-intelligence tools for AI-agent supply-chain security (AUDIT ▸ MODEL ▸ EXTEND). The anchor is skillsentry, a static auditor that never executes what it scans; around it sit an agentic threat-modeler (STRIDE + Elevation-of-Privilege gap ritual) and opt-in extensions. Each plugin stands alone; per-plugin detail lives in each plugin.json.

metadata.note: skillsentry is the trust anchor (defaultEnabled). The agentic plugins are opt-in (defaultEnabled:false) so enabling the platform never auto-runs non-deterministic code. The covenant proposes (PR); the deterministic core + a human dispose.

plugins.name: skillsentry
plugins.displayName: skillsentry — static supply-chain auditor (the trust anchor)
plugins.description: Audit an AI-agent skill/plugin for supply-chain attacks before it runs (PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK), via the in-repo skillsentry CLI. Detection stays in the deterministic CLI, never the agent context.

plugins.name: threat-modeler
plugins.displayName: threat-modeler — STRIDE/EoP gap ritual & self-improvement covenant
plugins.description: Map the probe set onto STRIDE + agentic axes, run the Elevation-of-Privilege gap ritual, and propose new rules via PR (never self-merge).

plugins.name: threat-stack
plugins.description: Front door: greet, explain the AUDIT ▸ MODEL ▸ EXTEND flow, list installed plugins, and consolidate readiness. A thin orchestrator that delegates to the specialists.

plugins.name: supersize-semgrep
plugins.description: Opt-in Semgrep SAST extension (separate trust model); shells to an external semgrep if installed and never touches the auditor's zero-dependency core. Off by default.
